note_en: 不仅……，还要…… adds a further requirement on top of the first: 我不仅要翻译出意思，还要注意语气和礼貌的程度 "I not only have to get the meaning across but also have to watch the tone and level of politeness." It works like English "not only... but also," but when both parts share a subject, 不仅 goes after the subject (我不仅要……), and English-style inversion ("Not only do I...") never happens. Note also 翻译出意思: the complement 出 means "bring out," so the phrase is literally "translate the meaning out."
